messages:
Ana M.: quick heads-up — initial int8 sweep for the new reranker shows an NDCG@10 regression on the long-query holdout. posting numbers and a brief reproduce so we can triage.
Sam K.: numbers?
Ana M.: baseline fp16 ndcg@10=0.342, mrr@10=0.158. int8 (global) ndcg@10=0.318 (-7%), mrr@10=0.150 (-5%). these are on the long-query holdout (>=120 tokens).
Jordan: is this the same candidate pool/order as prod? any dedupe or sharding differences?
Ana M.: same candidate id set, we kept ordering. holdout was sampled from product queries with doc texts preserved. dedupe step ran earlier in pipeline (same).
Maria P.: could be formatting/truncation. long queries get truncated differently in the quant pipeline? we recently switched trunc strategy to tail-drop for the bringup variant.
Lee T.: also check tokenizer parity — the int8 build uses our new tokenization binary (subword updates). small shifts there change score anchors.
Ana M.: good call. quick repro command I used:```bash
python eval_rerank.py \
  --model rerank-xl \
  --weights /snapshots/rerank-xl-int8.pt \
  --holdout data/holdouts/long_queries.json \
  --batch 32 \
  --truncate tail \
  --tokenizer /envs/tokenizers/v2/tokenizer.json
```
CI Bot: smoke-eval failed: https://ci.company/reports/5532109876 (ndcg drop > 3 sigma) :warning:
Sam K.: can you try left-pad instead of tail-truncation? padding/truncation side makes a big diff on long-query models we saw before.
Ana M.: ran left-pad quick test: int8 ndcg@10 -> 0.328 (still -4% vs fp16). so padding side helps but doesn't fully close gap.
Jordan: try per-layer quant (per-channel for weights) instead of one-shot global int8. sometimes last-attention layers are more sensitive.
Maria P.: also test forcing fp16 for first/last 2 layers as a hybrid — cheap to test and often recovers most signal.
Ana M.: plan: 1) run per-layer/per-channel int8 sweep 2) hybrid fp16 for head/tail 3) run with canonical tokenizer binary (parity check) 4) seed + batch-size sensitivity (32 vs 8)
Lee T.: I'll re-run with tokenizer v1 and attach token-delta stats (token counts, split positions).
Sam K.: also capture candidate score distribution shift (mean/std) and top1 swap rate. if int8 just rescales scores we can rescale at postproc.
Ana M.: good. I'll open an issue with assigned tasks and attach the failing CI logs. cc @Jordan @LeeT @MariaP — will post updates here when each ablation finishes. :thumbsup:
CI Bot: issue created: #1342 — rerank-int8-longquery-holdout-triage.
Maria P.: if we can't fully recover, we should produce a short rollback plan for Dedicated customers — fallback to fp16 model and schedule a more thorough quantization.
Ana M.: noted. I'll keep thread updates concise. next update in ~4h after the first ablations.
Sam K.: thanks — appreciate the quick repro. :eyes:
